description: OPTIONAL BUT JUSTIFIED. Append-only audit trail for privileged actions. The admin panel can suspend and delete users, so there must be an immutable record of who did what to whom. Write-once, read-rarely - kept out of every hot path. A capped TTL (see indexes) bounds growth.

adminEmail.description: DENORMALISED snapshot. An audit log must stay readable even if the admin account is later purged.

targetUserId.description: REFERENCE -> users._id, when the action targets a user.

targetId.description: Generic target id for non-user targets (template, portfolio, ...).

metadata.description: Free-form context (reason, before/after values). Intentionally schemaless - audit payloads differ per action. Must never contain passwords, hashes or tokens.

createdAt.description: Immutable. There is no updatedAt: audit rows are never edited.
